question_text: Asked to design a schema for a social media application with users, posts, comments, and likes. Follow-up: how would you handle indexing for fast feed retrieval?
Explained how they would scale a real-time chat system to handle 10,000 concurrent users. Discussed WebSocket connection management and Redis pub/sub for horizontal scaling.
Asked about React component lifecycle, when to use useEffect vs useMemo, and how to avoid unnecessary re-renders in a complex component tree.
Asked to design a REST API for a task management application. Discussion around authentication, rate limiting, pagination, and error handling strategies.
Walked through setting up a CI/CD pipeline for a Node.js application with a PostgreSQL database, including database migrations and zero-downtime deployments.
